train.params.lrHelp: Supports 5e-5 / 1e-2 / 0.00005; kept as entered without numeric reformatting
train.params.quantizeConditioningHelp: The conditioning half = the text projection, both modulation layers, the time embedding and the final output layer: 16 Linear weights in total, 0.62 GiB. Off by default: the error in each per-block modulation gets amplified by every layer, and half a GiB saved is not worth risking image quality.
train.params.quantizeDtypeHelp: Only applies when the field above is not "No quantization (bf16)". nf4 saves more VRAM; fp8 keeps image quality steadier.
train.params.quantizeFfn: Quantize FFN only (saves VRAM, slightly slower)
train.params.quantizeFp8: fp8 e4m3 (closer to bf16, double the VRAM)
train.params.quantizeHelp: Quantization only affects training VRAM and speed; it does not change the exported LoRA format
train.params.residentHelp: Fewer resident blocks = trade PCIe bandwidth for VRAM, about 15% slower per step; only lower it when the card cannot fit the model, and the trainer keeps lowering it by itself on OOM.
train.params.schedulerHelp: Applies selected schedule after warmup; effective value shown below
train.params.seedHelp: Fixed seed makes training reproducible with the same config
train.params.warmupHelp: Integer = step count; 0 < value < 1 = ratio of total steps (e.g. 0.05 → 100 of 2000 steps)
train.preflight.desc: Preflight checks YAML, model paths, cache readiness, and output directory; start training from Console once passed
train.preflight.title: Preflight failed
train.preview.batchHelp: Default 1 = sample one prompt at a time, the flattest peak; 0 = run every prompt in one go.
train.preview.loraHelp: Stacked only while generating sample images, never during training. A distilled LoRA usually runs at 4–8 steps with guidance scale 1, which cuts preview VRAM and time by an order of magnitude.
train.preview.negativeHelp: Global negative prompt written to preview.safetensors; per-prompt overrides are not supported yet
train.preview.promptsHelp: Text encoding writes prompts to preview.safetensors; required for sample preview while training only uses the latent index
train.preview.seedHelp: -1 draws a new seed per job; the training seed is unaffected.
train.preview.sizeHelp: Width and height must be multiples of 16.
train.preview.uncondHelp: Leave blank for [22]; recommended 22 / 24 / 26, comma-separated for multiple layers
train.preview.vaeDeviceHelp: CPU decoding uses host memory only: a few seconds slower per image and no VRAM at all.
train.preview.vaeDtypeHelp: fp16 applies to sample decoding only: the difference is invisible to the eye, but the result is not bit-exact.
train.profile.noWorkspaceNew: No workspace yet, create one first
train.profile.note: Config, cache, runs, and logs are stored in
train.profile.noteTail: ; each run gets its own directory, and its config is config.yaml inside it.
train.profile.saveAsDesc: Copy the current config from {name} into a new workspace
train.runConfigActual: The config this run actually used, read-only
train.setup.desc: Check model files, datasets, and cache step by step; jump directly to anything missing
train.setup.title: First-time setup check
train.state.disabledTitle: When disabled, checkpoint only saves weights and cannot resume exact training state
train.state.help: When disabled, checkpoint only saves weights and cannot resume exact training state
train.title: Training settings
train.validation.previewResidentRange: Preview residency takes -1 or an integer from 0 to {max}
train.validation.residentRange: Resident blocks must be an integer from 0-{max}
train.vram.note: A new run uses every default and applies no preset. Picking a preset only fills in that tier's values; each field stays editable afterwards.
train.vram.offloadHelp: Writes every gradient-checkpoint boundary to pinned host memory and reads it back for the recompute. Costs about a tenth of step time and frees about 1 GB at 1024². Needs gradient checkpointing.
train.vram.residentHelp: Offloaded blocks sit in host memory, so a lower resident count costs more system RAM.
train.yaml.note: Read-only preview. Form changes update here immediately; use the form to edit or export YAML
train.yaml.title: YAML read-only preview
workspace.confirm.deleteText: Deletes config, cache, run artifacts, logs, baseline, and exports for {name}. This cannot be undone
workspace.confirm.title: Confirm deletion
workspace.desc: Each workspace is a folder under workspaces/; deleting the folder directly is also safe and it will be recreated on next use
workspace.emptyText: Create a workspace in Training settings first, then return here to manage it
workspace.noRuns: No runs in this workspace yet
workspace.runsDesc: Deleting a run permanently removes its checkpoint, samples, and metrics
workspace.selectPrompt: Select a workspace to view details
